verdict.rationale: E2B is sandbox infrastructure for running AI-generated code and external agents. The evidence shows a pre-built template with Claude Code installed and support for hosting third-party coding agents in sandboxes. That is runtime hosting for agents the user brings and drives, not a built-in E2B assistant to which a user can delegate tasks inside the product. A SaaS platform could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies, but no evidence of it exists.
